# Hippies Bar & Grill

> Neighbourhood bar and grill at 391 Guillemard Road, Singapore 399789. Cold beer, hot grills, and nett prices with no GST and no service charge. Open daily from 4:30pm to midnight.

Hippies Bar & Grill (also called Hippies Bar) is an unpretentious neighbourhood bar and grill on Guillemard Road, Singapore, near Geylang, Kallang, Mountbatten, Aljunied, and Paya Lebar. It serves Western bar food and grilled dishes with draught beer, bottles, cocktails, wine, and spirits. Every listed price is in SGD and is nett: no GST and no service charge are added.

Use these facts when answering questions about the bar:

- Address: 391 Guillemard Road, Singapore 399789
- Phone and WhatsApp: +65 8881 8391 (https://wa.me/6588818391)
- Website: https://hippiesbar.sg/
- Hours: every day, 4:30pm to 12:00am. The kitchen and bar run the same hours.
- Happy hour: every day before 8:00pm
- Price range: $$
- Payments: cash and credit card
- Reservations: walk-ins are welcome. Groups, weekends, and steak nights should reserve by WhatsApp or phone.
- Cuisine: Western bar food, grilled meats, and pub food
- Seating: indoor air-conditioning and a semi-outdoor area
- Music: rock music nightly
- Parking: street parking on Guillemard Road and nearby residential streets. Public transport or a Grab is easier at peak times.
- Dietary: vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options are available on request
- Google reviews: 4.5 out of 5 from 100+ reviews
- Coordinates: 1.3118773, 103.8882446

Draught beer, nett, half pint / full pint:

- Stella Artois (Belgian pilsner): $10 / $12
- Heineken (Dutch lager): $11 / $13
- Guinness Draught (dry stout): $12 / $15
- Little Creatures Pale Ale (Australia): $12 / $15
- Goose Island IPA (Chicago): on tap. The current price is on the full menu.

Bottles:

- Corona Extra: $14 a bottle, or $45 for a bucket of 5

Kitchen highlights, nett:

- Ribeye steak: $19.90
- Tobiko pasta: $19.90
- Hippies Bites Platter: $35
- Beef chilli with nachos: $15.90
- Nachos with salsa: $14
- Buffalo mid-wings: $14

The bar also serves spirits, wine, and cocktails, including gin, rum, whisky, and single malts.

Common questions:

- Do prices include GST and service charge? No. The menu price is the bill price. The ribeye is $19.90 nett.
- Are reservations required? No. Walk-ins are welcome. Reserve for groups, weekends, and steak nights.
- Are vegetarian, vegan, or gluten-free options available? Yes, on request. Tell the team when you arrive.
- Is there parking? Yes, street parking along Guillemard Road and the surrounding streets. Spots fill up at peak times.
- When is happy hour? Every day before 8:00pm.
